authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: given that the inventory levels of NAND is higher than DRAM, the company has decided to further reduce NAND production.
precision_guard: This later vintage supports an additional NAND production-reduction decision tied to NAND inventory being higher than DRAM. It is a contemporaneous management decision/commitment, not by itself proof that the additional reduction had already been executed. It does not attach the earlier >50% investment magnitude to NAND output, wafer starts or bit supply.
researcher_paraphrase: SK hynix said in Q2 2023 that NAND inventories remained higher than DRAM and it therefore decided to further reduce NAND production.
source_title: SK hynix Reports Second Quarter 2023 Financial Results
